about: Sale calendar read by the AI Limits apps (releases after iOS 1.4.10 and Android 1.1.31). A sale shows only between start and end (UTC), on the listed platforms, and only while the store price of that plan is really below its usual price. Lower the store price first, then add the sale here. App Store applies a US price change at 04:00 UTC, so iOS entries use 04:00Z; Play changes follow the Mac's scheduled job (00:10 Kyiv).
